text.en:
Creation of an Inter-Agency Committee. There is
hereby created an Inter-Agency Committee chaired by the Department of
Social Welfare and Development (DSWD and co-chaired by the
Department of Finance (DOF to oversee, coordinate, monitor and
evaluate the implementation of the Philippine Plan of Action for Older
Persons. The Committee shall also review and regularly update the Plan
and be responsible for the widest possible dissemination of information
about the Plan. The Committee shall include as members the following
1).
1).
0).
National Economic and Development Authority
Department of Education, Culture and Sports
Department of Health
Department of Science and Technology
Department of Interior and Local Government
Department of Labor and Employment
Department of Trade and Industry
Housing and Urban Development Coordinating Council
Government Service and Insurance System
Social Security System
National Anti-Poverty Commission
Philippine Information Agency
Coalition of Services of the Elderly
Federation of Senior Citizens Associations of the Philippines
Philippine Retirement Authority
Philippine Retirement Authority Members Association

An appropriate focal point for older persons' concerns or
any other similar mechanisms shall be instituted in each concerned
department, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of the government,
including government-owned or controlled corporations and local
government units, to ensure the implementation and monitoring of the
Plan, review and updating of programs and projects identified for each

The Committee is hereby authorized to call upon any
department, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of the National
Government, including government-owned or controlled corporations and
LGUs, to assist and ensure the full implementation of the programs and
activities contained in the Plan.

All government agencies are hereby enjoined to allocate
necessary funds from other sources for the remainder of CY 2000 to
support the implementation of the Plan. Appropriation for succeeding
years shall be incorporated in the budget proposals for congressional

Effectivity, This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this (TU day of July in the Year
of Our Lord, Two Thousand.
By the President:
RONALDO B. ZAMORA
Executive Secretary
PEE Hologram 119007
